## Feature Proposal
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you are proposing.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or workflow limitation?
*Example: As an administrator, managing patient case imagery requires...*

## Proposed Solution / User Experience
Describe the solution you would like to see implemented:
- How does the feature behave?
- Which pages or backoffice components are affected?
- Are there specific UI/UX requirements?

## Privacy & GDPR Considerations
Does this feature handle personal data, media, or clinical records?
- [ ] Yes (explain safeguards below)
- [ ] No

## Alternative Approaches Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, wireframes, or screenshots about the feature request here.
